lines: You still have their hoodie in your closet.
You only pull it on when no one sees.
Your mind ties that shirt to safety.
So you think the memory is love.
They aren’t missing you, they miss the calm you gave.
Release it and breathe fresh air.
Follow for more daily psychology about people and relationships.

caption: Holding onto objects won’t hold onto the past. Save for later.
